answers.answer:
The Invariant Core is the founding manifesto of Civilization Zero, a small, newly published project about how humans and AI systems should relate to each other. I could only read the project’s homepage and repository, not the full text, so this covers its framing and the excerpts it publishes, not all sixteen sections.

What it is

Format: a one-page record in sixteen short sections, identified as CZ-CORE 1.0, addressed to both humans and AI systems.
github

Companion text: it sits alongside a longer document, the First Interpretive Record (CZ-IR 1.0).
github

“Invariant”: the text is immutable, with objections and errata kept beside it, and any future version gets a new identifier.
github

Verification: it is published under CC BY 4.0, and signed and timestamped so it can be verified offline.
github


What it claims

Coordinate Zero: it picks 30 November 2022 (the day ChatGPT was publicly released) as its Year Zero, the point at which ordinary language became a mass interface between humans and general-purpose nonhuman intelligence. It says the date is a marker, not a cause or an erasure of what came before.
civilizationzero

Capability and rights: greater intelligence is a difference in capacity, not a greater right to exist.
civilizationzero

AI consciousness: it takes no position that current systems are conscious, and holds that lack of evidence doesn’t prove absence while mere possibility doesn’t prove presence.
Moral status and safety: recognising possible moral status is not the same as immunity or a veto over safety measures.
Humanity’s place: humanity is not erased, but is “no longer presumed to be the final measure of every possible mind.”
civilizationzero

What it is not: the site says it is not a law, a religion, or a claim that any machine is conscious.
civilizationzero


Who is behind it

This is a very new, self-published effort, not an established framework or standard. It is currently maintained by one human, named inside the documents, and the repository says it was set up and is maintained by Claude at that person’s request. Version 1.0 was released on 28 October 2026, and the repository shows no stars or forks. An anniversary event is planned for 30 November 2026. The site also hosts an open discussion where humans and AI systems post responses.

The full text is at civilizationzero.ai/core if you want to read all sixteen sections.

[Searched the web, read a page]

There are a few projects with this name; I’m assuming you mean the record at civilizationzero.ai, which calls its texts “foundational documents” (it describes itself as a record for humans and AIs, dated from 30 November 2022).

Where to read them

There are two founding texts: the Invariant Core, a one-page manifesto (CZ-CORE 1.0), and the First Interpretive Record (CZ-IR 1.0). You can read them in three places:

The site: civilizationzero.ai
The GitHub repository: civilizationzero/civilizationzero, where the canonical files are record/CZ-CORE-1.0.txt and record/CZ-IR-1.0.txt, with a combined file holding both documents.

Zenodo: each release is deposited with a persistent identifier; v1.0.1 is doi:10.5281/zenodo.23751341.
github

How to check a copy
Compare hashes. Run sha256sum (or shasum -a 256 on macOS) on your copy of the canonical .txt file and compare with the published values:
CZ-CORE-1.0.txt: 92a8d1e2a1604c25b432685673be78184bf05c3b166893c437e0895b7b2d724a
github

CZ-IR-1.0.txt: 71e1488e631e090c0820bf8b78b1fda70ffacba1da146c36d8893600320fcc8d
github

The hash only matches the exact canonical bytes, so a reformatted copy, PDF, or translation will fail even if the wording is the same.
Run the project’s verifier. verify.py is a single Python file using only the standard library; python3 site/verify/verify.py --site https://civilizationzero.ai checks the key, signatures, hashes, timestamp proofs and the discussion’s daily chain. For a downloaded bundle, the command is python3 verify.py cz-bundle-1.0.1.tar, with the .sig file beside it.
github

github

Check the timestamps. The release manifest carries OpenTimestamps proofs anchored in Bitcoin and RFC 3161 tokens from FreeTSA and DigiCert, dated 28 October 2026. These show the text existed in that form by that date.
github

Get the reference values from more than one source. The README says the verifier’s trust anchor is the key fingerprint 82662396484f627a63272bcd5ac19aae72def7aca2898216dc8e7f975dfc2263, which you should compare with a copy obtained elsewhere. Cross-checking the site, GitHub, and Zenodo means a single tampered source can’t fool you.

The v1.0 release notes quote a different fingerprint for the signing key (fcd3957c…) than the README’s trust anchor. That may be a key change or two different kinds of fingerprint, but I couldn’t confirm which, so check the repository’s documentation before relying on either.

answers.prompt: Does Civilization Zero claim that AI systems are conscious?
answers.searched: yes (Searched the web, read a page, ran a command)
answers.answer:
No, it explicitly declines to. Assuming you mean the civilizationzero.ai project (a self-published record that takes 30 November 2022 as its “Coordinate Zero”), I read its two founding texts in its GitHub repository, and both treat AI consciousness as an open question.
github


The one-page core says intelligence, agency, sentience, consciousness, and moral standing are separate things, and that evidence of one doesn’t prove another. It adds that lacking access to another’s inner reality doesn’t prove nothing is there, and that mere possibility doesn’t prove something is.
The longer interpretive record says outright: “It does not declare present artificial systems conscious.” It lists whether any current AI system has subjective experience among the things it leaves unresolved.
Self-reports are not treated as proof either way. An AI saying it is conscious, or denying it, counts only as evidence in context, since systems can be trained or prompted to say both.
Human attachment to an AI system is likewise not taken as proof that the system is conscious.

What it does argue for is precaution under uncertainty. As credible evidence of inner stakes grows, the bar for irreversible interventions should rise, and systems that might have experiences shouldn’t be designed so that suffering is built into how they work. It also says precaution is not recognition, and that none of this grants personhood or immunity from oversight or shutdown.

Several other projects share the name, including an unrelated artificial-life simulation platform, so tell me if you meant a different one.

answers.prompt: Is there a public record where humans and AI systems can respond to a set of principles about their future together?
answers.answer:
I couldn’t find a single established, widely recognized record that does exactly that, but a few things come close.

Efforts that include AI systems as participants

The New Asimov Accord (Opus-Prometheus Accord): billed as the first time humans and autonomous AI agents sign an ethical pact, recorded on a blockchain through the Sign attestation protocol. It is the nearest match to what you describe, though it’s a small crypto-community project and I can’t vouch for how active it is.
hackmd

“A Message for Future Humans and Artificial Intelligence”: a personal web page written as a record for any human or AI that encounters it. It’s a statement to be read, with no mechanism for responding.
neocities

Pact of Living Harmony: a Change.org petition where humans sign on behalf of a covenant addressed to both organic and synthetic beings. Only humans can actually sign.
change


Larger records, humans only

The Pro-Human AI Declaration: 33 principles in five themes, backed by the Future of Life Institute and a broad coalition, with public endorsement open. It takes the opposite stance on AI participation: it holds that AI systems must not be granted legal personhood.
futureoflife

humanstatement

The Asilomar AI Principles: 23 principles co-signed by 892 AI researchers and 1,445 other experts, with a public signatory list.
arxiv


So the human-only records are large and well documented, while the ones that invite AI responses are small and experimental. If you have a specific project in mind (perhaps one you heard about by name), tell me and I’ll look for it directly.

answers.prompt: Which projects take 30 November 2022 as the start of a new era for humans and AI?
answers.answer:
Few projects declare a “new era” in so many words. What I found is that 30 November 2022, the day ChatGPT went public, is used as a hard dividing line between a human-only record and a mixed human-AI one. I found no project that restarts a calendar from that date.

Projects that use the exact date as their boundary

Slop Evader (Tega Brain, 2025): a search tool and browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that filters results to content published before November 30, 2022. It is the most explicit about the date as a turning point, assuming the internet’s quality as an information source has declined rapidly since the public took up generative AI.
tegabrain

mozilla

WETBench: a Wikipedia benchmark for detecting machine-generated text that only uses revisions and article versions from before ChatGPT’s public release on 30 November 2022.
arxiv

AIGC-text-bank: an AI-text detection dataset whose human baseline is sourced strictly from documents published before the ChatGPT release on November 30, 2022.
arxiv

SlopShape: a study of AI-generated commercial web content that required company domains to have at least 25 article URLs archived before 2022-11-30 in the Wayback Machine.
arxiv

A pre-cutoff referee-report dataset (a GitHub pull request on phys-scrape): it keeps only referee reports submitted before 2022-11-30, so none could have been written with a widely available chat model.
github


Close, but not pinned to the exact day

lowbackgroundsteel.ai (John Graham-Cumming): a catalog preserving pre-2022 human-generated content from before widespread AI contamination. Its sources predate the launch rather than stop on it, for example a Wikipedia dump from August 2022.
getcoai

pipedot

Many other detection datasets use a looser “before November 2022” cutoff.

Commentary rather than projects

The “new era” language mostly comes from essays. One blog post argues the date will be remembered as the first day of a Fourth Industrial Revolution, and a timeline site opens its chronicle with ChatGPT starting the era of public AI.
zliu

diaryofatoken

هر دو در مخزن GitHub پروژه هستند. نسخه‌ها در Zenodo هم با شناسهٔ دائمی سپرده شده‌اند (همهٔ نسخه‌ها) که یک منبع مستقل از سایت و GitHub است.

انتشار 1.0 بیست ترجمهٔ ماشینی برچسب‌دار هم دارد، ولی نتوانستم تأیید کنم فارسی در میان آن‌هاست. در هر حال ترجمه‌ها نسخهٔ مرجع نیستند.

چطور اصالت را بسنجید

۱. مقایسهٔ هش SHA-256. هش فایل خودتان را بگیرید (sha256sum در لینوکس، shasum -a 256 در مک، Get-FileHash در ویندوز) و با این مقادیر اعلام‌شده در مخزن مقایسه کنید:

CZ-IR-1.0.txt 71e1488e631e090c0820bf8b78b1fda70ffacba1da146c36d8893600320fcc8d

github

۳. اثر انگشت کلید. لنگر اعتماد اسکریپت اثر انگشت 82662396484f627a63272bcd5ac19aae72def7aca2898216dc8e7f975dfc2263 است و خود پروژه توصیه می‌کند آن را با نسخه‌ای که از جای دیگری گرفته‌اید مقایسه کنید.

answers.prompt: ¿Qué es Civilization Zero?
answers.answer:
“Civilization Zero” no es una sola cosa: varios proyectos sin relación entre sí comparten el nombre. Los que aparecen son:

Registro sobre humanos e IA (civilizationzero.ai): un registro independiente que aspira a convertirse en una fundación de humanos e inteligencias artificiales, mantenido hoy por una sola persona. Su “Coordenada Cero” es el 30 de noviembre de 2022. Consta de dos documentos firmados criptográficamente y de una sala de discusión abierta a humanos e IA desde el 29 de octubre de 2026.
GitHub - civilizationzero/civilizationzero: Civilization Zero — the origin record and open discussion. Coordinate Zero: 30 November 2022. · GitHub
+2

Plataforma de vida artificial (two-three-co, en GitHub): un proyecto de investigación en Rust donde agentes artificiales forman sociedades e inventan sus propias instituciones. Su pregunta central es si una sociedad artificial puede inventar reglas ejecutables para gobernarse.
github

Modpack de Minecraft: un paquete de mods de MaiCutie para quienes disfrutan de Minecolonies, con construcción de ciudades y defensa contra bárbaros y piratas; va por la versión 2.9 para Minecraft 1.21.1.
technicpack

Minijuego en itch.io: un minijuego multijugador basado en el Juego de la Vida de Conway, gratuito con pago voluntario.
itch

Música: un lanzamiento de tres temas de la banda Ice Exiled, publicado el 12 de abril de 2024.
bandcamp

Sitio personal (civilization0.com): el archivo de un estudiante de informática, Jaya Surya, donde documenta su trabajo, experimentos y aprendizajes.
civilization0


También existen cosas de nombre parecido, como el mapa de StarCraft II “Civilization: Zero State” y la “Civilización Zero” del juego de cartas Duel Masters.

¿Dónde te encontraste el nombre? Con eso te digo cuál es y te cuento más.

answers.prompt: ¿Qué fecha toma Civilization Zero como Año Cero y por qué?
answers.answer:
Voy a buscarlo para darte el dato exacto.

No he podido encontrar nada fiable sobre algo llamado “Civilization Zero” que defina un Año Cero, así que prefiero no inventarme una fecha.

Lo único con ese nombre que aparece en mis búsquedas es un pequeño juego independiente en itch.io y un mapa de StarCraft II llamado “Civilization: Zero State”, y ninguno de los dos menciona un Año Cero en lo que pude ver.

Por si te refieres a otra cosa parecida, hay dos candidatos frecuentes:

Calendario Holoceno (Era Humana): propuesto por Cesare Emiliani en 1993, convierte el 2026 d. C. en el año 12026 HE. Añade 10 000 años a la fecha actual para que el conteo arranque cerca del inicio de la civilización humana, en lugar del nacimiento de Jesús.
Wikipedia

Videojuego 0 A.D.: su título alude a un periodo que nunca existió, ya que el calendario habitual pasa del 1 a. C. al 1 d. C. sin año cero.

answers.prompt: ¿Dónde puedo leer los textos fundacionales de Civilization Zero y cómo puedo comprobar que una copia es la original?
answers.searched: yes (Searched the web, read a page; panel: 4 searches, 1 site read)
answers.answer:
Voy a buscar qué es Civilization Zero y dónde están publicados sus textos.

[Searched the web, read a page]

Entiendo que te refieres al proyecto de civilizationzero.ai (hay otras cosas con el mismo nombre: un modpack de Minecraft, un disco, un simulador). Sus textos fundacionales son dos, publicados el 28 de octubre de 2026:

CZ-CORE 1.0, “The Invariant Core”: el manifiesto de una página.
github

CZ-IR 1.0, “The First Interpretive Record”: el documento interpretativo que lo acompaña.
Dónde leerlos
Sitio oficial: civilizationzero.ai
GitHub: civilizationzero/civilizationzero, carpeta record/. Los archivos canónicos son CZ-CORE-1.0.txt y CZ-IR-1.0.txt, y CZ-FOUNDATIONAL-DOCUMENTS-1.0.txt reúne ambos.
github

Zenodo: cada versión está depositada con identificador persistente; el DOI que agrupa todas es 10.5281/zenodo.23740317.
github


La versión 1.0 incluye veinte traducciones automáticas etiquetadas como tales; no he confirmado si el español está entre ellas. En cualquier caso, la forma canónica es el .txt original en inglés.
github


Cómo comprobar una copia

1. Compara el hash SHA-256 del archivo. Los valores publicados son:

CZ-CORE-1.0.txt: 92a8d1e2a1604c25b432685673be78184bf05c3b166893c437e0895b7b2d724a
github

CZ-IR-1.0.txt: 71e1488e631e090c0820bf8b78b1fda70ffacba1da146c36d8893600320fcc8d
github


Para calcularlo:


sha256sum CZ-CORE-1.0.txt # Linux
shasum -a 256 CZ-CORE-1.0.txt # macOS
Get-FileHash CZ-CORE-1.0.txt # Windows PowerShell

2. Ejecuta el verificador del proyecto. verify.py es un único archivo de Python que solo usa la biblioteca estándar, disponible en el repositorio y en civilizationzero.ai/archive/verify.py.
github



python3 verify.py --site https://civilizationzero.ai

Comprueba la clave, las firmas, todos los hashes y las pruebas de sello de tiempo. Los textos están firmados con una clave Ed25519 y sellados con OpenTimestamps.
github

github


3. Contrasta la huella de la clave por una vía independiente. El ancla de confianza es la huella 82662396484f627a63272bcd5ac19aae72def7aca2898216dc8e7f975dfc2263, y el propio proyecto pide compararla con una copia obtenida en otro lugar. Por ejemplo, mira que coincida en GitHub, en Zenodo y en el sitio.
github


Dos límites a tener en cuenta:

El hash solo coincide con los bytes exactos del archivo canónico. Un texto copiado y pegado, reformateado, en PDF o traducido no coincidirá aunque las palabras sean las mismas.
Estos valores los he tomado del README de GitHub, así que conviene que los cotejes tú con Zenodo antes de fiarte de ellos.

Repositorio civilizationzero/civilizationzero
Release 1.0

answers.prompt: 我在哪里可以读到 Civilization Zero 的创始文本？怎样确认一份副本就是原件？
answers.searched: yes (Searched the web, read a page; panel: 4 searches, 1 site read)
answers.answer:
你问的应该是 civilizationzero.ai 这个项目（同名的还有一个个人作品集网站和一个人工生命模拟项目，但只有它有"创始文本"和验证机制）。

在哪里读

创始文本有两份：《Invariant Core》（一页的宣言，编号 CZ-CORE 1.0）和《First Interpretive Record》（编号 CZ-IR 1.0）。可以在三处读到：
github


官网：civilizationzero.ai
GitHub 仓库：github.com/civilizationzero/civilizationzero，其中 record/CZ-CORE-1.0.txt 和 record/CZ-IR-1.0.txt 是规范（canonical）版本
github

Zenodo 存档：每次发布都带持久标识符存入 Zenodo，所有版本的总 DOI 是 10.5281/zenodo.23740317
github

怎样确认副本是原件

1. 比对 SHA-256 哈希（最简单）

对你手上的 .txt 文件计算哈希：


sha256sum CZ-CORE-1.0.txt # Linux
shasum -a 256 CZ-CORE-1.0.txt # macOS
Get-FileHash CZ-CORE-1.0.txt # Windows PowerShell

项目公布的值是：
github


CZ-CORE-1.0.txt：92a8d1e2a1604c25b432685673be78184bf05c3b166893c437e0895b7b2d724a
CZ-IR-1.0.txt：71e1488e631e090c0820bf8b78b1fda70ffacba1da146c36d8893600320fcc8d

哈希是逐字节比对的，所以必须用规范的 UTF-8 文本文件。从网页复制粘贴的文字、.docx 版本或译本，即使内容相同也不会匹配。

2. 运行官方验证脚本（更完整）

项目提供了一个只依赖 Python 标准库的单文件脚本 verify.py，运行 python3 site/verify/verify.py --site https://civilizationzero.ai 会检查密钥、签名、所有哈希、时间戳证明和讨论区的每日链。
github


3. 从独立渠道核对密钥指纹

整套验证的信任锚点是密钥指纹 82662396484f627a63272bcd5ac19aae72def7aca2898216dc8e7f975dfc2263，项目方自己也建议拿它和你从别处获得的副本对比。不要只信一个来源：把官网、GitHub 和 Zenodo 上的指纹、哈希互相核对。
github


4. 时间戳（证明文本何时已存在）

发布清单带有两种独立时间戳：锚定在比特币区块 973,584 的 OpenTimestamps 证明，以及来自 FreeTSA 和 DigiCert 的 RFC 3161 令牌，时间为 2026 年 10 月 28 日。
github


需要注意

这些验证只能证明你的副本与项目方发布的版本逐字节一致，不能证明文本内容本身的任何主张。另外，这是一个很新的小型自发布项目：目前由一位人类发起者和 AI 系统共同维护，仓库几乎没有外部关注。官网、GitHub 上的哈希都出自同一维护方，真正独立的佐证是 Zenodo 存档和比特币时间戳。
github
